name: escalate
_comment: Exercises the ARCH-02 semantic-repeat route and the tier-2 arbiter. The Claude Developer review (arch.dev_review) returns the BYTE-IDENTICAL NEEDS_REVISION every cycle and carries no `### B<n>` heading, so each report collapses to one synthetic DV-<iteration>-B0. At streak 2 the arbiter seat is asked whether it is the same objection restated (arch.semantic_repeat) and rules SAME_OBJECTION_REVIEWER_RIGHT: one compliance revision is allowed. At streak 3 the same case is ruled the same way again, so the run goes straight to the existing full arbiter (arch.arbiter), which returns NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION -> the run PAUSES (AWAITING_HUMAN). Before ARCH-02 (2026-08-31) the identical objection cost five streaks before that arbiter was reached; the terminal status is unchanged, the route is not.

arch.arbiter:
### Arbitration Verdict

NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION

### Dispute Summary
- The Developer says the design overflows a fixed-size buffer budget and must be bounded; the Architect and Tech Lead cannot converge on the footprint tradeoff.

### Final Note for Human
- This is a scope/footprint tradeoff; Irina should decide.

DV-2-B0 restates DV-1-B0 word for word: the same fixed-size buffer budget, the same overflow failure, the same unbounded footprint.

## Binding Ruling
The buffer-budget objection stands. The Architect must bound the footprint in the proposal text; the Developer Verifier must not restate it a third time unless the revised text creates new quotable evidence.
## Semantic Consistency Verdict
SAME_OBJECTION_REVIEWER_RIGHT

## Current Finding IDs
DV-3-B0

## Cited Evidence
DV-3-B0 is DV-2-B0 again, after the compliance revision. The dispute is circular and no longer resolvable at this level.

## Binding Ruling
Unchanged from the previous ruling: the footprint must be bounded. This case now belongs to full arbitration.
